steps.title: Write tan in terms of sin and cos

lines.text: Use $\sin(A+B)=\sin A\cos B+\cos A\sin B$ and $\cos(A+B)=\cos A\cos B-\sin A\sin B$.

lines.tex: &= \frac{\sin A\cos B+\cos A\sin B}{\cos A\cos B-\sin A\sin B}

steps.title: Divide top and bottom by $\cos A\cos B$

lines.tex: &= \frac{\dfrac{\sin A\cos B}{\cos A\cos B}+\dfrac{\cos A\sin B}{\cos A\cos B}}{\dfrac{\cos A\cos B}{\cos A\cos B}-\dfrac{\sin A\sin B}{\cos A\cos B}}
&= \frac{\dfrac{\sin A}{\cos A}+\dfrac{\sin B}{\cos B}}{1-\dfrac{\sin A}{\cos A}\cdot\dfrac{\sin B}{\cos B}}
